title: Concept graph
description: A map of the ideas inside one project, each explained in plain words with real code from the repo.

project.description: Slug of the project. The file is named <project>.json.

repoPrivate.description: True hides the repo link in viewers.

commit.description: Short git commit the snippets were taken from.

id.description: category/slug for level 2, category/slug/slug for level 3. The parent (id minus last segment) must exist. The category must be one of the ids in taxonomy.json.

summary.description: One plain sentence, shown on hover.

explanation.description: Markdown, 120-250 words: what problem it solves, how it works here, what breaks without it, why this choice.

related.description: Ids of related nodes in the same file.

custom.description: True when the owner asked for this concept by hand; the skill never removes those.

lang.description: Highlighter language id: ts, tsx, go, python, sql, json, bash...

lines.description: Line range in the source file, e.g. 12-48.

snippet.description: The code, trimmed to the 10-40 lines that matter.

note.description: What to look at in this snippet.
